goal: Prevent fee-bumped replacement transactions from getting an earlier locktime than the original
Eliminates an on-chain fingerprint that identifies Bitcoin Core wallets during fee bumps
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: General support for preventing backdated replacement locktimes (molnard, nervana21, polespinasa)
Verified through local functional and unit testing (molnard, nervana21)
Unaddressed objection: functional test fails to properly restore mocktime (polespinasa)
Contested suggestion: keep locktime logic inside the anti-fee-sniping block (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an unnatural on-chain fingerprint on fee-bumped transactions
The privacy issue affects fewer than two percent of replacements so the impact is modest
